notes.title: Nerd Simulator - Devlog #2
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Nerds![/h3]

We’ve been hard at work improving Nerd Simulator, and here’s what’s coming soon:

[previewyoutube=X5M6Mu6Ccg4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]

[list]
[*] We’ve polished the customization system for Mervin’s room. You’ll now have access to dozens of new furniture items to truly express your own style. From cluttered chaos to minimalist chic, it’s your call.
[*] We’ve also changed the interaction system. All in-room interactions are now visually grounded and connected to specific objects. In our opinion, this approach is much more aesthetic and engaging, and we hope you’ll feel the same.
[*] Introducing nightmares. While sleeping, Mervin might experience bizarre and terrifying dreams that can affect his energy level the next day. Expect terrifying encounters with healthy food, cleaning products, and other horrors.
[*] Painting is now available. Mervin can now relax by painting original pieces. Once finished, your artwork can be sold for a small profit. Who knows, maybe there's a hidden artist in him after all. 
[*] Fistfights have been added. Don’t want to take out the trash or clean up when your mom tells you to? No problem. Use brute force and settle it with a good old-fashioned brawl (be warned – these won’t be easy).
[/list]

BREAKING NEWS: We’re introducing third-person camera sequences tied to specific mini-games and quests. During these moments, you’ll fully take control of Mervin, bringing you closer to his struggles and making the gameplay more immersive than ever.

More updates are in the works. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Check out our new game: Secret Seeker!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Nerds!
[/h2]

We want to announce our brand-new game: [b]Secret Seeker[/b] — a dark and atmospheric blend of [b]Roguelike[/b], [b]Exploration [/b]and [b]Hidden Object[/b] genres.

You’ll dive into strange dimensions, uncover hidden items. With every object found, the mystery deepens...

Featuring:

[list]
[*] A fresh mix of Roguelike and Hidden Object genres — every run is unique and tense.
[*] Explore eerie and mysterious locations across parallel dimensions.
[*] Race against time — fail the mission, but keep your knowledge and progress.
[*] Upgrade your own evolving museum of strange artifacts and forgotten stories.
[*] Experience deep immersion through atmospheric sound and environmental storytelling.
[/list]
Think you can uncover the truth?

[h2]Secret Seeker is coming soon to Steam. Add it to your wishlist now!
[/h2]

notes.title: Nerd Simulator - Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Nerds![/h2]

We've just rolled out a new update with a number of bug fixes and small UX improvements. Thanks for your continued feedback and support – keep it coming!

[h3]Bug Fixes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where dumbbells would float in the air after workouts.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the binder to be activated earlier than intended.
[*] Fixed interaction issues with the dresser in the room.
[*] Fixed a critical bug that could break the game if the Big Dig installation was interrupted.
[*] Fixed an issue where music would randomly stop playing.
[*] Clicking on the painting no longer causes it to change instantly.
[*] Need bars are no longer "clickable," preventing manual value changes.
[/list]
[h3]UX Improvements:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the size of the rotation buttons in the "Traffic Issues" task for better usability.
[*] During the tutorial, it's now only possible to order the keyboard from Alfazone (other items are blocked).
[*] Simplified the Jobber registration task by removing the Quit button.
[/list]
[h3]Minor Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The book now displays the correct game title.
[*] Removed duplicated lines from several dialogues.
[/list]


As always, let us know if you run into any issues or have suggestions for improvements by joining our Discord! More updates are on the way! 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/ZTq9SdVpGC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130036/97967c497badb09c35ffa1059d7c63b542596902.png[/img]
[/url]
– The Nerd Team
